optimizedDescription.value: Conservative language-neutral symbol resolution over declarations, aliases, public bindings, and type hierarchies.

optimizedContext.value:
# Resolve Symbol Reference

## Rules

- Accept workspace, requested symbol text, optional file/public-surface/symbol-space/broad-kind/member-semantics/owner/build-context. Structured identity fields authoritative. Canonical references MUST round-trip with escaping; MUST NOT ad hoc delimiter-split. `MemberForm` MUST NOT remain input field.
- Text `Tipo.miembro` or `Tipo::miembro` resolves by equality on stored `qualified_name`. MUST NOT require file/public surface/language; MUST NOT run every adapter or pick default language. `::` compares as stored dotted spelling. Return every match; one match resolves; file/public surface filters visibility; no remaining match → unresolved. Comparison uses only stored `qualified_name` value — MUST NOT derive qualified name from owner/member/other fields. Logical symbol without stored `qualified_name` MUST NOT match owner-qualified text. Session-backed and persisted stores MUST return same candidates for equivalent facts.
- Other human owner-qualified text parsed by language adapter from proven context order: explicit language → file-extension of anchored file → file-extension of anchored public-surface. None / missing `symbolReferenceSyntax` facet / facet returns no candidates for non-simple text → `unresolved` (`REFERENCE_UNPROVEN`). MUST NOT fall back to generic dotted/delimiter parser, other language adapter, or default language. Identifier case/normalization follow source language; path/workspace normalization separate.
- Canonical target = logical symbol retaining every contributing declaration. Overload sets/declaration merging/equivalents → one logical target, not false ambiguity. Multiple declarations of same logical symbol/overload set from selector → `status: 'resolved'`. Only competing distinct logical symbols → ambiguous. Target exposes workspace, module/package, owner, symbol space, simple name, member form, declaration locations, stable canonical reference independent of line/column.
- Discriminate canonical logical target vs exact physical declaration. Logical result: `LogicalSymbol` + complete deterministic contributing declarations + ordered evidence. Exact-declaration: selected `SymbolNode` + logical target when exists. Canonical IDs/owner-qualified/public selectors resolve at logical layer; file/line/column/occurrence MAY select physical. MUST NOT infer target kind from legacy `symbolId` or reduce logical to arbitrary first declaration. Ambiguity at request-selected target layer. Every selector entry point returns discriminated typed target; legacy physical `match` MAY accompany as derived compatibility only. Public compatibility changes need explicit discriminant/migration.
- Public export slot by public surface + exported name + symbol space; each proven route independently addressable binding identity with target/re-export provenance. Distinct aliases/duplicate routes/competing targets remain distinct. Local binding retains lexical scope/source-range; resolving local alias MUST NOT classify as public export. Anonymous/default exports addressable via public binding identity.
- Precedence: (1) exact current canonical logical id; (2) equality on stored `qualified_name` for dotted/`::` spelling (every equal logical symbol); (3) exact declaration in addressed file/owner; (4) exact public binding in addressed public surface; (5) statically proven scoped import/alias; (6) statically proven hierarchy path per language precedence. Owner-qualified: resolve owner path first, member second — MUST NOT search terminal member name alone. Unique same-name without proven path MUST NOT resolve. Conditional/platform alternatives remain separate unless build context selects. Cyclic paths terminate without duplicates. Public binding: surface+name+space; file path alone MUST NOT select; target MAY live other workspace.
- Package-specifier import local binding → precedence 5 when target persisted; report ordered provenance through `import:package` to public binding + logical target. Unpersisted package import → unresolved local; MUST NOT search same-name in package workspace. `import:package` step is shared provenance vocabulary; MUST NOT depend on language to follow.
- Status exactly one: `resolved` | `ambiguous` | `unresolved` | `missing` (only when current complete index proves addressed target absent). Non-resolved: stable reason code + ordered candidate summaries + ordered typed evidence path.
- VCS ref equality alone MUST NOT prove freshness. Consume batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` for every addressed resource and contributing declaration file. Addressed source file assessed as file; public surface without file assessed as addressed resource. Batch deduplicates; MUST NOT embed fs/repo/hash/persistence. Exact file-anchored MAY use targeted evidence despite unrelated global staleness; corpus-completeness decisions stay `unresolved` when global health stale/unknown. Bad/unknown evidence → `unresolved` never `missing`. Assessment failure → `freshness-unknown`. Fresh complete addressed file/surface may prove `missing`. Provider/generation failures remain infrastructure errors.
- Declared/overriding member beats inherited; contract-qualified selects contract member. Language precedence governs inherited/trait/mixin/embedded/promoted/abstract/default members. Ancestor traversal queries requested member under reached owner; owner alone is not member evidence. Preserve owner path + ancestor-member declaration. Competing inheritance → ambiguous; same-name accessor forms need semantics when language cannot select; implicit interfaces require proven method sets; cycles terminate.
- Batch resolution shares one health snapshot/provider lifecycle; indexed bounded traversal; no full-graph scan per query. Ordering/status/reasons identical across backends.

## Constraints

- No stored-link or sidecar mutation.
- No fuzzy matching, edit distance, rank-based guess, runtime reflection, computed imports, monkey patching, unproven value flow.
- Adapter syntax analysis stays in language adapters.
